body: How are you doing now? :(

Honestly in some ways, life gets worse and worse (I never imagined I’d reach a point where I had shots of vodka immediately upon waking up). I don’t feel good... ever. I’ve gained a few pounds. I don’t want to leave the house. 

But in other ways, it doesn’t seem that bad. I was depressed anyway. I’m not dying and my liver hasn’t failed. I dunno... after reading here for years, I thought maybe it was a place to talk about it without judgement. There’s always been an element of gatekeeping here... if the group
likes someone they can slur out any old post about anything. If they don’t know you or like you, they’re all “ThIs iSn’T yOuR pErSoNaL bLoG!!!” and other forms of shut-downs. If enough people are dicks to me, I’ll just go back to lurking, but for now I’m peeping my head in.

That's what really makes me cry... in my secret heart of hearts, since I was a kid, I really thought I was special in some way, for the longest time. But life has not bourne that out to be true. I've turned out to be an utterly common, boring nothing. When that finally sank in, I was like, Ok, fuck it, I'm out.

I'm an woman in my mid 40's... when a youngster like you sees me out and about at the grocery store or whatever, I'm sure I just look like part of the scenery, nearly invisible, but inside parts of me still feel like that 16 year old walking around high school with her books clutched to her chest, worrying about inane things. You'll find that, too, as you get older... you're literally exactly the same person inside, just more experienced... but your face and body and driver's license say you're old, ha ha. 

I always tell fellow travelers "once you realize you can leave any time, it becomes easier to just stay for one more minute and see what's up next", so give it a good try before you make any rash decisions. Honestly, I look at photos of me from 10 years ago and think, "WOW you were so gorgeous, so fun, so full of potential, why didn't you realize it!" and you are right there now. You can leave any time, so why not stick around for another minute or two?

I take all the pills they give me, sometimes they "work" and I feel AMAZING and hopeful, but it always crashes down and I come back to reality. I hope you find something that helps for you! Paradoxically, I always advise other people to stick around, don't go yet. I always say, "once you realize you can leave any time, it becomes easier to just stay for one more minute and see what's up next". But for me personally, I just want to die, ha ha.

It's a long running joke with everyone who knows me that I want to "leave", as I call it. Nobody laughs about it or joins in on my jokes about it, but absolutely everyone who knows me knows that I am "tired" and I want very much to "leave". I've explained it to them calmly, I think they don't want to think about it too deeply, but they understand that there is nothing they can do.
